chat.t: Hey.
Yo.
Meet me at the park.
This is an urgent order from Freya!
You'll regret it if you don't come.
It's a seriously fun incident, you know?
Seriously, seriously fun.
Supplies needed! Cola and popcorn!

o: I have no money, get them yourself.

chat.t: ...Then I have no choice!
I'll just have to post 'that' photo we took last time on the plaza bulletin board.

o: Dammit, when did you take a photo of what again?!
Spit out where you are, quick.

chat.t: Yo.
A person might not know!
How can you run away while I'm in the middle of looking through the book!

o: My head hurt so much that I took stomach medicine.

chat.t: Huh? Does that cure headaches and make stomach aches better too? Sweet, jackpot!
Oh, by the way, there was a small quiz show application form at the back of the book.
Should I enter too?

o: Do you want to go embarrass yourself somewhere?
No, actually, go ahead and apply.
Because laughing at you would be pretty fun.

chat.t: Huh? You already think I'm just gonna fail?
Just you wait. I'll study hard!
And knock that smug look right off your face!

o: Bring it on, bring it on.
Of course, you're a hundred years too early.

chat.t: Hmph!

lines.t: Park
Hey.
Whoa, you scared me!

Hand it over.
'That' photo.
...Huh?
I said, hand it over!

W-Was there such a thing?
What are you talking about?
The photo you threatened me with in our texts earlier!!
Ah! That!

Of course!
I was kidding!
...What?

Did you think it was real?
You're so naive!
Just you wait.
I'll make sure you can't eat in peace for a while.
Oh, I'm so scared!
I'm leaving.

Wait! Wait up!
I actually just baited you to show you something fun.
It's true that there's a super fun event!
*Sigh*... So what is it?
That is...

Tada!
The Common Sense Encyclopedia!!!
Freya is... reading a book?
Looks good to use as a brick.
Is that a newly bought trivet?
Even I can read books!
Of course, I didn't buy it myself. It caught my eye when I was taking a nap at the Humanitas Library last time...
How on earth did you end up borrowing such a thick book?

This is seriously so fun!
The book is called '10,000 Common Sense Quizzes!'
General knowledge? Quizzes?
Wow, that really doesn't suit you at all.

Hey, that's a bit harsh!!
I just borrowed it because it looked fun!
Besides, I wanted to build up some basic knowledge anyway.
What do you think? At this rate, who's to say Freya won't enter a contest later and win first place?!
Dream on.
If it's a riddle quiz, you might have a chance.

What.
Are you looking down on me right now?
I can do it too if I put my mind to it!
Can you not kill my motivation when I'm just getting started?
Where do bananas grow?
Bananas?
Uh... Don't they grow at the supermarket?

I mean!
They appear on the shelves anew every time I go!
I rest my case.

chat.t: [Web Message]
This is an invitation from Freya, a participant in Humanitas' <Quiz! Is This Right Trivia Show!>.

o: What, a quiz show? You're really entering?
If you cancel now, you probably won't be charged a fee.

chat.t: Cancel? What are you talking about!
I told you last time!
I'll prove that I'm not a fool!
Anyway, you're coming tomorrow, right?
I'd feel so much better if a teammate came as an audience member!
Oho, what makes you so busy?
Yeah right, you can't even secure your own dinner.

o: And whose fault is that, you freeloaders?

chat.t: Ugh, whatever! If I win first place this time, you'll have to acknowledge my greatness!

o: Please fail, please fail, please fail.

chat.t: You're really no help at all.
Hey, aren't I amazing?
Honestly, give credit where credit is due.
They say they give prize money and a trophy too!

o: How did you bribe the host?
No way Freya is that smart.
Are you an AI that kidnapped Freya and cloned her body?!

chat.t: W-What do you mean! I told you I studied really hard!

o: So, how did you bribe them again?

lines.t: Station Front Street
I went out to the plaza to watch the quiz show Freya was participating in.
Where on earth did this dummy go?
Over here, over here! Hehe!
I knew you'd come.
Someone needs to be there to comfort you when you fail the qualifiers.
Someone needs to be there to laugh at you when you fail the qualifiers.

Oh, come on!
I told you I studied really hard!
What are you going to do if I actually win first place?

Are you sick or something?
It's not like just anyone can win.

Participant Number 27, Freya.
Are you not here?
Gasp!
The quiz show has already started!

Right here, right here!
I'm running over right now!
With that, Freya vanished like a flash...
And before long...
Now! Things are heating up here at <Quiz! Is This Right Trivia Show!>!
And now, let's welcome Participant Number 27!

Yeees!
I'm coming, I'm coming!
On the electronic board over there... Freya?

Bwahaha!
Today's winner is none other than me, Fre... Argh!

Oh dear, are you okay?
Of all things, you had to bump right into the camera...
I can only see her massive boobs!
It's great that her stupid face isn't showing!!
Ouch, that hurt...
Are you showing off your boobs in the middle of the plaza?
You're really something else.
Now, since we have other participants and we're short on time, let's get straight to the questions!
What is the 'Law of Conservation of Mass'!
Me! Me!
Freya... buzzed in first?

The answer is!
Heavy things don't disappear! They stay heavy!

This is why I can't lose weight!
They say everything you eat stays in your body!
Ah, so what Freya is saying is that once you gain weight from eating, it doesn't go away!
Exactly!

Oho... is that the correct answer?
Drumroll, please...

Congratulations!
It is accepted as the correct answer!

Kyaah!
Science is the best!

What is this? Is this right?
That counts as a correct answer?
Surprisingly, Freya buzzed in faster than anyone else on the following questions too...

Me!
Bananas grow in the refrigerator!
And the reason is...?
Because no matter how many times you take them out of the fridge, they keep appearing!

Correct!
Bonus points will be awarded for linking it to the Law of Conservation of Mass you mentioned earlier!

...?
Is there something wrong with my head?
Thus, Freya pulled ahead of the others with an unrivaled score...
And with that, the 1st <Quiz! Is This Right Trivia Show!> has come to an end.
All participants, please step down from the stage and wait!

How was that? I did great, right?
Hurry up and tell me I did great!
Isn't your score in the negatives? It should be.
Hehe, thanks for the compliment!

No, I was insulting you.
It wasn't a compliment.
This is what friends are for! Getting encouragement at times like this!
Ugh... I shouldn't even bother.
Now, we will announce the results of the contest!
The result is obvious!
Yeah, the result is obvious!
I'm obviously in first place!

What are you talking about?
You're obviously in last place.

Oh, stop teasing.
But still, this is getting tense.
Congratulations!

The winner of the glorious 1st <Quiz! Humanitas Show!> is!
Freya!
Uh... really?
See.
I told you I'd win!?
The world has gone mad...

...In the end, Freya wouldn't stop bragging all the way back to the Hideout,
making me feel like I was losing my mind.

chat.t: [Breaking News] Huge news!

o: I can see right through you.

chat.t: What???
I just got out of the shower, how did you know?
Huh?!!!
Ugh... Oh, right!
I'm going to the award ceremony for that quiz show today!
Let's go together! Take some photos of me!!
In return, I'll buy you food with the prize money!
Hey
Yo
Meet at the park
No, I'm serious this time
They say they give medals instead of trophies if you win this quiz show!
But this time, it's teams of two...
Hehe, wanna go together?
Huh?
Hello?
Hey! You're in big trouble! It says your contact info is gone!
Whoa, crazy. I need to post this quick.

lines.t: Station Front Street
In the end, I was curious about the trophy Freya was going to get, so I hung out with her again.
Well, as long as it's fun, it's fine.
You're here?
As expected, M.A.D.'s biggest headache, Freya.
As expected, M.A.D.'s biggest pain in the neck, Freya.
W-What did you say?
Hmph, that's as far as your teasing goes.
Once I get my trophy, it's bye-bye forever to the past where I got teased for being airheaded.
I didn't go that far.
For someone who looks like they don't have a single worry.
I have... my own worries too, you know!
What is it?
Ah, it's a bit hard to put into words...
Do you know why I decided to go on the quiz show?
I mean, of course, I kind of like trivia quizzes and did it because I was bored.
But people keep treating me like an idiot, you know? Since they do it so much, I started wondering if I really am one.
...Especially since the person I want to impress keeps doing it too.
Ah... it just really bothers me.
So, I thought if I actually did well, everyone would shut their mouths...
I wonder if that'll really happen.
Dream on.
Geez, of course you'd say that.
Now, we will present the trophy to the winner of the 1st <Quiz! Is This Right Trivia Show!>!
Freya, please come up to the stage!

Kyaaaa!
Oh my gosh, I'm really going to the award ceremony!
(Yeah, my worry is how you forget your worries in three seconds.)
I won! I won! This is so exciting!
Now, the trophy presentation will be...
What's going on?
What is all this fuss suddenly!
This award ceremony is invalid!
W-What is it?

What do you mean 'what'!
I'm the person right next to you, whom you utterly crushed!
Tsk tsk... What an impolite brat.

The more I think about it, the madder I get!
The victory should have been mine!
What! What is your problem?!

I won fair and square!
If I did something wrong, I'll give you the trophy!
(In times like this, you're supposed to say 'over my dead body'...)
You! That is so mean.

You should have at least given us a chance to buzz in!
How could you buzz in all by yourself!
Huh? I mean, if you're upset, you should have buzzed in faster...
No, you pressed it like a flash of lightning, how are we supposed to keep up with that...
Are you looking down on us just because we're made of muscle?!
Seriously, you guys are impossible to talk to!
Ah, anyway, the trophy will go to the winner!

What do you mean by that!
Bring it on, all of you!
Haha! You'll have to work much harder to keep up with Freya!
Eek, run away!

Freya!
I knew I could count on you.
I knew the one to take the trophy would be you, Freya!
A genius's hands and feet move faster than you'd think!
Oh, as expected!
With a smart brain and a confident personality!
Freya is truly the rightful winner of this contest.
That flip-flopping skill is a work of art.
Yay!
Here is the trophy!
Street
Are you seriously going to be like this till the end?
Just what does it look like that you're hiding it so tightly on the way back?
I don't know... I can't even throw it away...
Hey, you worked hard to get that.
I thought you said it bothered you that everyone calls you stupid.
You said that as long as you had that trophy, nobody would look down on you anymore.
Ahahaha... hahaha... ha...
Are you seriously not going to show me?
Absolutely not! Never!
...Oh! Look over there! There's a popcorn cloud in the sky!
Where, where?!
Is this... the trophy?

Hey, what gives?!
There is no popcorn clou...
...You saw it.
...Yeah.
This is literally shaped like poop.
That's what I'm saying!!!
And what's with the "Not an Idiot" written on the side?!
St-Studying just to get something like this makes me look even stupider!!!
Ugh... All my hard work...
...Well, I don't really know what to say, but... hang in there.
With one mind and purpose, we kept our mouths shut and returned to the Hideout.
...And not long after, the trophy mysteriously vanished.
